About this Event

HIGH ON BOLLY PRESENTS
BOLLYWOOD HOLIDAYS
December has a main stage. It’s on Castro Street.
We’re opening the holiday season at OPAL with a live DJ spinning Bollywood Top 40 and EDM, then dropping the throwbacks you had on repeat way before you could drive.
 The second that intro hits, you lock eyes with your friend across the room. By the hook, the whole damn dance floor is singing every word.
Pull out the winter fit you’ve been saving. Think velvet, statement coats, and boots you can actually dance in. Get the fit pic, order a craft cocktail, and catch the live go-go performances under the lights.
Friday, December 4, 2026
10 PM till late
OPAL Nightclub, 251 Castro St, Mountain View, CA
Drop the link in the group chat. Grab your tickets and give December a proper opening night.

This is the ultimate desi party you won't want to miss!
Age Restriction: 21+ 🛑 (Please bring a valid form of ID - State issued ID/Driver License or Passport) No photocopies or digital ids will work. Club is Really strict about this🛑
*NO REFUNDS*
